features.label: Three-in-One Therapy
features.text: Combines motorized cold therapy, sequential calf compression for DVT prevention, and wound compression to reduce swelling and inflammation.

features.label: Reduces Pain and Swelling
features.text: Cold compression therapy targets post-operative pain, inflammation, and joint discomfort for knees, hips, shoulders, ankles, and the back.

features.label: Effective DVT Prevention
features.text: Sequential compression therapy improves circulation in the legs to help prevent Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) following surgery.

features.label: Customizable Recovery
features.text: Compatible with a range of Breg VPulse Thermal Compression Pads (sold separately) to target specific areas like knees, hips, shoulders, ankles, and the back.

features.label: Convenient Home Use
features.text: Lightweight, quiet, and portable design ensures hassle-free therapy at home, improving patient compliance.
